summary: Autonomix Medical filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-21 reverse stock split effective June 24, 2026, approved by stockholders at the October 30, 2025 annual meeting and authorized by the board. The split reduces outstanding shares from 11,409,344 to ~542,000 with no par value change and authorized shares remain at 500 million. Proportional adjustments apply to options/warrants. The action aims to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance and does not involve a tender or capital return event. Watch for continued listing requirements and potential future shareholder dilution.
